before: A rendered block widget taller than its native fallback overlapped the following content, unless a host wrote paragraph spacing into the shared document and its undo history.
after: `setBlockReservations` adds quarter-point, live-view-only flow height after named body paragraphs. Each session measures and reserves for its own rendering; save, export, and PAGEREF layouts omit reservations.
reason: Reservations are a local layout input. They write no model, operation, journal, schema, awareness, or transport field, and saved packages are byte-identical with or without them. Peers converge on identical documents while each lays out its own widget geometry.
